title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Computation of Seller Entitlement Restored by Substitution
content:
When a qualifying veteran buyer assumes a VA loan and substitutes their own entitlement, the seller's entitlement tied to that loan is restored to the seller. Under the VA Home Loan Guaranty, the entitlement restored to the seller by substitution is the entitlement charged to the loan less the entitlement already restored from it, never less than zero, rounded to the cent.

## Elements of the computation

| Element | Meaning | In this computation |
|---|---|---|
| Entitlement still charged | Sum of the entitlement charge entries on the loan less the sum of its restoration entries, never less than zero, read from the loan's entitlement history | As recorded |
| Substitution measure | The entitlement figure substitution starts from | The entitlement still charged |
| Partial claim reserve | A reserve percentage of the partial claim still owed on the loan, divided by one hundred | Reserve percentage 0 |
| Service-connected relief | A percentage by which the partial claim reserve is relieved; the reserve is multiplied by one minus that percentage divided by one hundred | 0 |
| Overpayment reserve | An amount reserved for a Disability Compensation Overpayment the seller owes | Nil |
| Repayment credit | A credit percentage of the partial claim repayments received on the loan, divided by one hundred | Credit percentage 0 |

## Assembly

The entitlement restored to the seller by substitution is the substitution measure, less the partial claim reserve after its service-connected relief, less the overpayment reserve, plus the repayment credit, never less than zero and never more than the entitlement still charged, rounded to the cent once at the end. The floor at zero is applied first, then the ceiling at the entitlement still charged, and only then is the figure rounded.

With the elements as they stand in this computation, the amount restored equals the entitlement still charged.

## Worked figures (hypothetical loans)

| Line | Loan 1 | Loan 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Entitlement charged | 72,000.00 | 72,000.00 |
| Entitlement already restored | 0.00 | 72,000.00 |
| Entitlement still charged | 72,000.00 | 0.00 |
| Substitution measure | 72,000.00 | 0.00 |
| Reserves and credit | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Entitlement restored to the seller | 72,000.00 | 0.00 |
